subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2399
title: Directs the Oregon Department of Administrative Services to establish a program to provide one-time grants to individuals who agree to serve in a uniformed service or public service program and complete the basic or initial training for the uniformed service or public service program.
headline: HB 2399 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2399 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
HB 2399 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
